scripts.db:reset: knex migrate:rollback --all --knexfile knexfile.ts && knex migrate:latest --knexfile knexfile.ts && knex seed:run --knexfile knexfile.ts

_comment_types_express: @types/multer declares a dependency on @types/express '*', which now resolves
to the Express 5 typings. Installed alongside our Express 4 typings it produces a
second, nested copy, and multer's RequestHandler stops matching our router's
(PathParams vs string) — a build that only fails on a fresh, lockfile-less install.
Both fields pin one Express 4 copy for the whole tree: resolutions for yarn (Render),
overrides for npm (local). Remove them when the server moves to Express 5.
